summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, reporting that its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders was adjourned for one week to July 9, 2026, due to lack of quorum. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance notification concerning a quorum shortfall and meeting adjournment.
